$comment: Copy to .claude/config/lint-gate.json in your project. All three keys are optional;
an absent key means that check never runs. There are no defaults — a command is only
run if the project asked for it by name.
format   runs after every Edit/Write, on that one file. Use {file} to place the path,
otherwise it is appended. The path is shell-quoted for you.
lint     runs on Stop and TeammateIdle, never per-edit.
typecheck runs on Stop and TeammateIdle, after lint.
Formatting is per-edit because it is a syntactic transform that is valid on any file
that parses. Linting and typechecking are not: an import added in one edit and used in
the next reads as an unused import in between, and a half-written function reads as a
syntax error. Reporting those would train the agent to undo correct work.
